description: Percent boxes for AR supporting documents (Label Studio style). Matches analyst annotations: Photo Documentation, Certificate, Attendance.

photo_documentation.notes: Header = logos + university/college/org/A.Y. Photo Documentation = title + narrative paragraph. Pictures = stacked photo evidence block.

photo_page.notes: Photo-only continuation page (no Photo Documentation paragraph).

certificate.notes: Works for Certificate of Participation and Certificate of Appreciation. Signatures often handwritten — leave transcription blank if illegible.

attendance.notes: Handwritten attendance / sign-in sheet. TEAM column included (present on form even if not always drawn in sample). SIGNATURES = presence region; OCR text optional.

label_glossary.HEADER: University / org logo header block (logos + institution lines + A.Y.)
label_glossary.PHOTO_DOCUMENTATION: Title 'Photo Documentation:' plus the activity description paragraph
label_glossary.PICTURES: Region containing stacked activity photos / evidence images
label_glossary.CERTIFICATE_TITLE: Main certificate heading (e.g. CERTIFICATE OF PARTICIPATION)
label_glossary.RECIPIENT: Awardee / organization name receiving the certificate
label_glossary.PURPOSE: Reason / citation paragraph for the award
label_glossary.SIGNATURES: Signature block(s) — officer / principal / guest speaker lines
label_glossary.TITLE: Attendance meeting / activity title
label_glossary.NAME: Names column (header + list of attendees)
label_glossary.TEAM: Team / role column between Name and Signature
